g.text: A few source details need careful reading
The deck uses table values and records discrepancies without silently correcting the paper.
Table 5 lists 8 STEM subjects in the lowest 10.
Do not normalize or invent the missing share.
Figure 4 has 57–94% for the Llama-70B target.
Prose claims column ranges of at most 10 pp.
These checks qualify particular summaries; they do not erase the observed answer flips.
Who Flips? arXiv:2606.16011v2 | Tables 2, 5, 7; Figure 4; full audit in references/digest.md
